panels.title: Labels over time by model and evaluator version

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT (s.created_at / $__interval_ms) * $__interval_ms / 1000 AS time,
       coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) || ' · ' || s.name || '@' || substr(s.evaluator_version, 1, 8) || ' · ' || coalesce(s.value_label, CASE s.value_bool WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END) AS series,
       count(*) AS scores
FROM scores s JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_id
WHERE s.created_at >= $__from AND s.created_at < $__to AND s.name IN (${evaluator:singlequote}) AND s.evaluator_version IN (${version:singlequote}) AND coalesce(s.value_label, CASE s.value_bool WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END) IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Distribution by model and evaluator version

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) AS model,
       s.name AS evaluator,
       substr(s.evaluator_version, 1, 8) AS version,
       coalesce(s.value_label, CASE s.value_bool WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END) AS label,
       count(*) AS scores,
       round(1.0 * count(*) / sum(count(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model), s.name, s.evaluator_version), 3) AS share,
       round(avg(s.value_num), 3) AS mean_value,
       round(avg(s.confidence), 3) AS mean_confidence
FROM scores s JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_id
WHERE s.created_at >= $__from AND s.created_at < $__to AND s.name IN (${evaluator:singlequote}) AND s.evaluator_version IN (${version:singlequote})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
ORDER BY 2, 3, 1, scores DESC

panels.title: Judge latency p50 / p95
panels.description: in-process worker only; `eval run` exports no metrics

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT j.created_at / 1000.0 AS time,
       j.evaluator,
       substr(j.evaluator_version, 1, 8) AS version,
       j.attempts,
       j.last_error,
       lower(hex(coalesce(t.otel_trace_id, t.id))) AS trace
FROM eval_jobs j JOIN traces t ON t.id = j.trace_id
WHERE j.status = 'failed' AND j.created_at >= $__from AND j.created_at < $__to AND j.evaluator IN (${evaluator:singlequote})
ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Low score or low confidence

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT s.created_at / 1000.0 AS time,
       coalesce(t.response_model, t.requested_model) AS model,
       s.name AS evaluator,
       coalesce(s.value_label, CASE s.value_bool WHEN 1 THEN 'true' WHEN 0 THEN 'false' END) AS label,
       round(s.value_num, 3) AS value,
       round(s.confidence, 3) AS confidence,
       -- The tail: Claude Code puts injected context before the request.
       CASE WHEN length(o.last_user_text) > 400 THEN '…' || substr(o.last_user_text, -400) ELSE o.last_user_text END AS last_user_message,
       substr(o.output_text, 1, 400) AS output,
       lower(hex(coalesce(t.otel_trace_id, t.id))) AS trace
FROM scores s JOIN traces t ON t.id = s.trace_id
LEFT JOIN trace_outputs o ON o.trace_id = s.trace_id
WHERE s.created_at >= $__from AND s.created_at < $__to AND s.name IN (${evaluator:singlequote}) AND s.evaluator_version IN (${version:singlequote}) AND (s.value_bool = 0
        OR ',$bad_labels,' LIKE '%,' || s.value_label || ',%'
        OR (s.data_type = 'numeric' AND s.value_num < $low_score)
        OR s.confidence < $min_confidence)
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC
LIMIT 50
